run_singlepoint_calculations: run singlepoint energy and force calculations on a batch of atomic structures using an ASE calculator
create_singlepoint_runner: create a SinglePointRunner with an ASE calculator and AtomsSequence input data to compute energy properties
write_results_to_json: write singlepoint calculation results as a compressed JSON file to a specified results directory
calculate_chunked_structures: calculate properties on a subset of structures by splitting input data across multiple array jobs
save_target_properties: save target properties from atoms.info alongside calculated energy and force results in the output
